Package com.mendix.systemwideinterfaces.core

Interface IMendixObjectMember<T>

All Known Subinterfaces:
MendixAutoNumber, MendixBinary, MendixBoolean, MendixDateTime, MendixDecimal, MendixEnum, MendixHashString, MendixInteger, MendixLong, MendixObjectReference, MendixObjectReferenceSet, MendixString

Represents a Mendix object member (attribute or association).
